🔥 android-sms-gateway | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling programmatic sending and receiving of SMS messages through an API, integrating SMS functionality into other applications and services.
✨ Key Features: • Send and Receive SMS via API • Support for Android 5.0 and above • Multipart messages • Message status tracking • Incoming messages viewer
📖 Summary: The Android SMS Gateway app transforms an Android device into an SMS gateway, allowing users to send and receive SMS messages programmatically via an API. It supports features like multipart messages, message status tracking, and real-time notifications for incoming messages through webhooks.
